title: Cyclic geometric sheet coordinates for constructible coefficient hearts
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$ and an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $m\ge1$, $k_m=\mathbf F_{q^m}\subset k$, $X_{0,m}=X_0\times_{k_0}k_m$, and $Y=X_{0,m}\times_{k_0}k$. Use the actual common-stage coefficient categories, constructible hearts and Weil sheaves of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], [def-weil-constructible-heart] and [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and the integral-normalized pullback comparisons of [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]. Write $g_X$ for geometric $q$-Frobenius on $X$, $H$ for geometric $q$-Frobenius on $Y$, and $P=Lg_X^*$ on the constructible heart [def-weil-frobenius-detailed].

There is a decomposition $k_m\otimes_{k_0}k\simeq\prod_{\sigma:k_m\hookrightarrow k}k$ and a corresponding covering of $Y$ by $m$ pairwise disjoint open-and-closed sheets. For the inclusion $j_0:X\to Y$ belonging to $k_m\subset k$, put $h_i=H^i\circ j_0$ for $0\le i<m$. Each $h_i$ is an isomorphism onto one sheet, all sheets occur, and $H^m j_0=j_0g_X^m$; $g_X^m$ is geometric Frobenius for the $k_m$-model. No $k$-linearity is asserted for $h_i$.

The functor $N\mapsto(h_i^*N)_{i=0}^{m-1}$ is an equivalence $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)\simeq\prod_{i=0}^{m-1}D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$, with cohomology computed componentwise, for finite coefficients $A_{E,n}$, integral coefficients $\mathcal O_E$, rational coefficients $E$ and common-stage coefficients $\Qlb$ as in [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. It respects coefficient reduction and scalar extension and restricts to an exact equivalence of the standard hearts. The functor $P$ on the heart of $X$ is an exact equivalence. Writing $Y_i$ for the sheet containing the image of $h_i$ and $r_i:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y_i$ for its factorization, each $r_i^*$ is an exact equivalence of hearts, even for these semilinear coordinates; $h_i^*=r_i^*\circ j_i^*$, where $j_i:Y_i\hookrightarrow Y$, is exact component restriction.

Through the specified pullback-composition comparisons, a constructible $k_0$-Weil sheaf $(N,\eta)$ on $X_{0,m}$ corresponds exactly to objects $A_i=h_i^*N$ and isomorphisms $a_i:A_{i+1}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_i$ for $i<m-1$ and $a_{m-1}:P^mA_0\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{m-1}$. Morphisms correspond exactly to tuples $u_i$ with $u_i a_i=a_i'u_{i+1}$ and $u_{m-1}a_{m-1}=a_{m-1}'P^m(u_0)$. These identifications are natural and retain the integral-normalized compositors after rationalization and passage to a common coefficient stage.

proof.text: Obtain the geometric clopen sheet package from [lem-zl-constant-extension-sheet-geometry]. Apply [lem-zl-constant-extension-sheet-coefficient-equivalences] to those same sheets, then [lem-zl-constant-extension-sheet-common-stage-equivalences] to pass these coefficient equivalences and their normalizations to the actual common-stage category.

Assemble the successor and return comparisons already defined in [def-zl-constant-extension-sheet-heart-data] componentwise into a natural isomorphism R ⋙ cycle ≅ H* ⋙ R. The component is exactly the prescribed successor or return comparison, so both HEq normalization clauses follow by selecting the appropriate branch. Naturality is the component comparison naturality.

The common-stage package makes R an equivalence. Transport invertible endofunctor algebras along the preceding comparison. This transport is fully faithful: lift a carrier map by R.preimage and cancel the comparison isomorphism to check its algebra square. For essential surjectivity choose a carrier preimage X of a given algebra A with b:R(X)≅A. Lift the isomorphism e_X^(-1) followed by cycle(b), str_A, and b^(-1) through the fully faithful R. Its transport is isomorphic to A via b. This is the explicit proof fixedPairTransportEquivalence, with no new postponed assertion.

The product.standard clauses identify the source heart-carrier condition with the componentwise target condition: apply true,0 and false,0 separately and combine pointwise. The target condition is invariant under isomorphism because each standard class is represented by an isomorphism at a finite field stage. Restrict the fixed-pair equivalence to these full subcategories using Equivalence.congrFullSubcategory. The resulting functor is definitionally the displayed IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso followed by the full inclusion, so identification is reflexive. Its finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation follows because it is an equivalence. Combine this constructed Weil-coordinate package with the preceding three parts to prove the original existential unchanged.
